CPU deadline gap is a recorded-region gap, not a guaranteed sufficient optimization target; uncounted costs and cumulative reserve matter.
A late nominally complete epoch with pointer drift cannot pass despite exact software accounting and no reported underrun.
Isolated family controls exist only for Meteor/Quasar; shapes groups opacity, clipped and sparse plain/math. Prices are retained-prefix family costs, not universal unit prices.
